phases.title: Phase 1: Python Core & OOP Mastery
phases.desc: Python fundamentals, conditionals, loops, lists, dictionaries, OOP classes & methods, and file handling.

phases.title: Phase 2: Data Science, NumPy, Pandas & SQL
phases.desc: NumPy arrays, Pandas dataframes, data transformation, SQL queries, and BeautifulSoup web scraping.

phases.title: Phase 3: Data Visualization & EDA
phases.desc: Matplotlib & Seaborn visual storytelling, distributions, bar charts, scatter plots, and EDA charts.

phases.title: Phase 4: Mathematics & Statistics for AI
phases.desc: Probability distributions, Bayes theorem, Linear Algebra vectors & matrices, and Calculus derivatives.

phases.title: Phase 5: Machine Learning Mastery & Projects
phases.desc: Supervised & Unsupervised ML: Linear/Lasso Regression, kNN, Logistic, Trees, Ensembles, SVM, Clustering & PCA.

phases.title: Phase 6: Developer Workflow & Version Control
phases.desc: Linux bash command line, file navigation, Git version control, GitHub branching, merging and collaboration.

phases.title: Phase 7: Deep Learning & Neural Networks
phases.desc: Artificial Neural Networks, PyTorch tensors, forward/backprop, CNNs for image classification, and RNNs for NLP.

phases.title: Phase 8: Reinforcement Learning & Deep RL
phases.desc: Markov Decision Processes, Q-Learning, Deep Q-Networks (DQN), Experience Replay, and epsilon-greedy exploration.

phases.title: Phase 9: Transformers, LLMs, RAG & OpenAI APIs
phases.desc: HuggingFace Transformers, Attention mechanisms, RAG architectures, Vector DBs, and OpenAI API integrations.

phases.title: Phase 10: Frontend Layout & Fullstack Web for AI
phases.desc: CSS Box model, Flexbox, CSS Grid, Flask web server, dynamic AI templates, and fullstack app development.

phases.title: Phase 11: Generative AI, GANs & Agentic AI
phases.desc: Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), Generators/Discriminators, and Autonomous Agentic AI frameworks with Streamlit.

phases.title: Phase 12: Production Capstone Projects
phases.desc: Fullstack Database AI app, Neural Style Transfer with AdaIN/PyTorch, and Real-Time Pose/Rep Counter CV app.

phases.title: Phase 13: MLOps, CI/CD, Docker & Kubernetes
phases.desc: CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, testing, AWS EC2, Kubernetes architecture, Pods, Services, and Helm.
